title: Season 1
overview: Matt Murdock attempts to balance his legal practice with his oath to protect Hell's Kitchen as Wilson Fisk mounts a formidable political campaign.

episodes.title: Heaven's Half Hour
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock navigates a changed New York City while Wilson Fisk sets his sights on higher political ambitions.

episodes.title: Optics
episodes.overview: Fisk manages public perception following a violent incident as Murdock investigates a troubling new court case.

episodes.title: The Hollow of His Hand
episodes.overview: A legal dispute exposes corruption reaching into the municipal justice system.

episodes.title: Sic Semper Systema
episodes.overview: Murdock's investigation collides directly with institutional opposition.

episodes.title: With Interest
episodes.overview: Old alliances are tested as street-level tensions escalate across Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Excessive Force
episodes.overview: A violent confrontation forces Murdock to reconsider his boundaries as a vigilante.

episodes.title: Art for Art's Sake
episodes.overview: Fisk consolidates control while Murdock seeks critical evidence to dismantle the burgeoning network.

episodes.title: Isle of Joy
episodes.overview: The conflict reaches a boiling point as Murdock prepares for an inevitable confrontation with his greatest nemesis.

episodes.title: Straight to Hell
episodes.overview: In the season finale, Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk confront the consequences of their choices on the streets of New York.
